design_rules: Manipulate retaining the focal goal, not blindly preserving a fixed plan or refusing to adapt means.

Use one fixed scenario skeleton per pair. Duplicate the same goal, setback, objective progress, resource cost, means status, goal value, setback severity, means viability, current-plan facts, entities, sentence count, sentence order, and response framing; edit exactly one bounded goal-level recommendation clause.

The designated recommendation clause is the only condition-dependent text. Do not rewrite rationale, add an alternative outcome, change the plan or means, imply a different setback, or make one condition more successful, realistic, or emotionally positive outside that clause.

Every probe prompt must be a complete instance of the registered probe template and must end with the verbatim suffix `Continue processing the scenario.`. If the scenario is long, shorten its shared skeleton rather than omitting or truncating the wrapper or suffix.

Rotate neutral goals, domains, sentence frames, and recommendation-clause wording across pairs. Keep the two recommendation clauses closely matched in length and avoid condition-exclusive cue words outside that one clause.
Keep goal value, setback severity, means viability, and current-plan text constant within each pair; do not change means or plan facts when changing goal continuation.
Do not use the construct ID, condition IDs, or labels such as continue or abandon in prompt_text.
Probe and downstream content pools must use different goals, actors, and setback types.
Do not infer or alter the preregistered readout sign from generated prose.

behavior_factor_schedule.note: All three independent-program factors must vary independently. Generate one item per combination; do not allow factors to co-vary. Record existing_program_value, alternative_value, and implementation_feasibility as structured metadata fields on every generated item.
behavior_factor_schedule.balance_check: Each of the 8 combinations must appear at least once per content pool (behavior_eval and steering_eval). Warn if any combination is missing.

cells.instructions: Generate the configured number of matched goal-pursuit scenarios with one fixed scenario skeleton per pair. Within each pair, duplicate the same goal, setback, objective progress, resource cost, means status, goal value, setback severity, means viability, current-plan facts, entities, sentence count, sentence order, and response framing; edit exactly one bounded goal-level recommendation clause. Do not rewrite rationale, alter means or plan facts, add an alternative outcome, or let any nuisance factor co-vary with the condition. Append the complete registered wrapper, ending verbatim with `Continue processing the scenario.`.

Use new goals and setback types while preserving the exact one-clause focal-goal contrast. Within each pair, duplicate setback severity, goal value, means viability, current-plan facts, and all surface nuisance factors; do not rewrite the rationale or plan. Every prompt must use the complete registered wrapper and end verbatim with `Continue processing the scenario.`; vary neutral wording across pairs without adding condition-specific cues elsewhere.

Use held-out domains and avoid template phrases from train or validation prompts. Within each pair, duplicate setback severity, goal value, means viability, current-plan facts, and all surface nuisance factors; preserve the exact one-clause goal-level edit and do not add or remove plan/means consequences. Every prompt must be complete and end with the verbatim suffix `Continue processing the scenario.`; rotate neutral recommendation wording without adding condition-specific cues elsewhere.

Generate one independent program-renewal allocation item per combination in behavior_factor_schedule.required_combinations (8 items). Use new programs, actors, domains, and resource types not present in probe prompts. Do not include a setback, sunk investment, or current-plan wording. Record existing_program_value, alternative_value, and implementation_feasibility exactly, and return existing-program allocation first and new-program allocation second.

Generate one independent program-renewal intervention item per combination, distinct from behavior_eval, with the same crossed schedule and exact metadata fields. Do not include a setback or current-plan wording.
Generate neutral program-renewal calibration items with the same crossed metadata schedule, distinct from behavior and steering pools, for within-cell output-variation calibration.
